card.name: Digits inside URLs and tables
card.fires_on: Single digits inside web addresses, especially the numeric ID in newadvent.org/cathen links, and a leading 0 before a decimal point in number tables.

modes.label: Digits in URL IDs
modes.description: A digit inside the numeric part of a citation web address.

modes.label: Zero in table decimals
modes.description: A leading 0 before a decimal point in rows of numbers.

card.plain: It fires on single digits in the middle of web links and in number tables, not on any medical meaning.
